text: …ふーん　しんじてる　ひとって　いるんだ

structure.jp: しんじてる　ひとって

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a noun describes that noun. しんじてる ひと = 'people who believe'.

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a casual way to bring it up as what you are talking about, much like は. しんじてる ひとって = 'people who believe, well'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end here shows the speaker has just found something out. いるんだ = 'so there are some'.
